lines: He neither sits in thought nor tells a bead — yet may it dawn for him, with no rule first.
Just so, just so — O Śiva's light — we bow to him who loves.
sanskrit_cite: na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam | evam eva śivabhāsas taṃ numo bhaktiśālinam

lines: My self stays young, drinking Your love's nectar —
greyed as if with road-dust, dust that is passion.
sanskrit_cite: ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san | lokayātrārajorāgāt palitair iva dhūsaraḥ

lines: For those who've won that wealth — lovers homed in Your city —
may even their world-road walking be that same unfolding.
sanskrit_cite: labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām | saṃcāro lokamārge 'pi syāt tayaiva vijṛmbhayā

lines: Lord — where world within world stands face to face with You,
what is not the lover's ground? where does his prayer fail?
sanskrit_cite: sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare | kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetram mantraḥ kvaiṣām na siddhyati

lines: They win — the drunk, high on love's nectar-wine!
Second to none, yet never without You beside them, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ | advitīyā api sadā tvaddvitīyā api prabho
notes: dvitīyāḥ holds both readings: predicative second and bahuvrīhi having-You-beside (live L0 fork); the couplet keeps both.

lines: Lord of the endless-bliss sea — Your truth is known by just such ones:
the flooded, thick-drenched in love's bliss-nectar.
sanskrit_cite: anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te | tādṛśa eva ye sāndrabhaktyānandarasāplutāḥ

lines: You alone, self's Lord, are all men's nature, and all men love within the self — so this love stands on its own ground.
Who knows it, knowing by drowning — let him conquer.
sanskrit_cite: tvam evātmeśa sarvasya sarvaś cātmani rāgavān | iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ
notes: samāveśayuktyā (Kṣemarāja: by immersion's means) carried as knowing by drowning; jayet kept optative.

lines: Lord — the known destroyed, who would not see You standing all alone?
Even in the known-knower churn, lovers find You easy.
sanskrit_cite: nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ | vedyavedakasaṃkṣobhe 'py asi bhaktaiḥ sudarśanaḥ

lines: As the Goddess — endless-bliss lake, dearest — stands unparted from You,
so may one love of mine stand — unparted.
sanskrit_cite: anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā | aviyuktāsti te tadvad ekā tvadbhaktir astu me

lines: O All — for lovers, everything causes the gaining of You.
This knowing-road stands threefold: by joy, by sorrow, by bewilderment.
sanskrit_cite: sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho | saṃvinmārgo 'yam āhlādaduḥkhamohais tridhā sthitaḥ

lines: From tasting Your love's nectar, Master — even knowing's highest state
turns in my mouth to unwine-sourness.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā | daśā sā māṃ prati svāmin nāsavasyeva śuktatā
notes: nāsava read as un-wine (vinegar as anti-wine), answering v05's wine.

lines: Those to whom Your love's great lore has come as practice —
they alone know the real: knowing, unknowing, both.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā | vidyāvidyobhayasyāpi tā ete tattvavedinaḥ

lines: This speech-creeper, from the root, opening in order —
sprinkled with Your love's nectar, may its fruit swell with that sap — for me.
sanskrit_cite: āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī | tvadbhaktisudhayā siktā tadrasāḍhyaphalāstu me

lines: Be Śiva, then sacrifice — and the lover, become, is so declared.
For You alone are the body's pith, assayed by lovers in oneness.
sanskrit_cite: śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate | tvam eva hi vapuḥ sāraṃ bhaktair advayaśodhitam
notes: Lakshmanjoo witness: activity-embrace, not shunning — yaj kept as sacrifice, body kept as pith.

lines: For lovers, what is not proof toward oneness with You?
And for the lowest, what but veils — heaped toward failure?
sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ | tadasiddhyai nikṛṣṭānāṃ kāni nāvaraṇāni vā

lines: Some time, some place, by yoga You may be got — Lord, that's the cheat.
Else how do You shine, here blazing, in every state, for lovers?
sanskrit_cite: kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā | anyathā sarvakakṣyāsu bhāsi bhaktimatāṃ katham

lines: Untouched by breath-withdrawal and the rest — this is the great difference:
devotion's portion-takers stay gathered even waking — past the yogins.
sanskrit_cite: pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam | yogibhyo bhaktibhājām yad vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ

lines: No yoga bidden, no self-burning, no rite-rule — none of it prescribed.
On this straight Śiva-road, love alone is praised.
sanskrit_cite: na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate | amāye śivamārge 'smin bhaktir ekā praśasyate

lines: My cover fire-shattered from all sides by love's play of light —
I who face all things bare — may even my thoughts perish.
sanskrit_cite: sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama | pratyakṣasarvabhāvasya cintānām api naśyatu

lines: One word — Śiva — camped on the tongue-tip, always — and every sense-thing tasted.
In lovers only. Whatever that is — ah!
sanskrit_cite: śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā | samastaviṣayāsvādo bhakteṣv evāsti ko 'py aho

lines: In the calm-waved, cool, clear, sweet love-nectar sea — tasting its otherworld sap, steady —
who is counted a nobody?
sanskrit_cite: śāntakallolaśītācchasvādubhaktisudhāmbudhau | alaukikarasāsvāde susthaiḥ ko 'nāma gaṇyate
notes: anāma read as of-no-account (a nobody); the crux is kept as status inversion, not resolved.

lines: Why would the likes of us not chew Your love's great herb —
such a one whose very next taste, Lord, is called freedom?
sanskrit_cite: sādṛśaiḥ kiṃ na carvyeta bhavadbhaktimahauṣadhiḥ | tādṛśī bhagavan yasyā mokṣākhyo 'nantaro rasaḥ

lines: Those alone count as wealth, Lord, by the good's measure —
whatever fattens trusted feasting on Your love's sap.
sanskrit_cite: tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ | tvad bhaktirasasambhogavisrambhaparipoṣikāḥ

lines: They've caught some of love's nectar-pith who, fallen in this passion-mud and all the rest,
come up unsmeared.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhaktisudhāsāras taiḥ kim apy upalakṣitaḥ | ye na rāgādi paṅke 'smiṃḷ lipyante patitā api

lines: Powers down to freedom — fruit is just a limb-name on love's ripe creeper.
In some.
sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣv aṅgeṣv eva phalābhidhā | bhavadbhakter vipakvāyā latāyā iva keṣu cit

lines: Strange, Lord: this mind, pain-seed by nature — sprinkled with Your love's sap,
ripens into freedom's great fruit.
sanskrit_cite: citraṃ nisargato nātha duḥkhabījam idaṃ manaḥ | tvadbhaktirasasaṃsiktam niḥśreyasamahāphalam
